requirementSummary: Calculate DX Coil Height by summing the heights of all populated Cooling Circuits and update the total automatically when any Circuit Height is edited.
businessRules: When a Cooling Package is entered, the system runs calculations and populates the Cooling Circuits.
DX Coil Height must be set to the sum of the heights of all populated Cooling Circuits.
If a user modifies the height of any circuit, the DX Coil Height must be recalculated and updated immediately.
developerConsiderations: Implement logic to sum the heights of all populated circuits and display the result in the DX Coil Height field.
Ensure the DX Coil Height field refreshes in real time when any circuit height value is changed.
ambiguities: The source and format of the initial Cooling Circuit data are not specified.
Units of measurement for circuit heights are not defined.
No validation rules are described for circuit height inputs (e.g., allowed range, precision, required format).
Behavior when circuits are added or removed after the initial load is unclear.
